title: AI21 Beats Claude Opus 5.5 at 33x Lower Cost with Nemotron 3.5
summary:
AI21 Labs spent three weeks collaborating with firms like Gong and Deel to post-train NVIDIA's latest Super VL model into specialized tools for corporate use. The resulting models reached performance levels that meet or exceed the quality of general frontier AI, but at a smaller cost. A specialized model for Deel achieved 88.5% accuracy on an 8-country payroll benchmark, performing 8% better than Claude Opus 5.5 while running at 33x lower cost, while a cybersecurity model for Alice improved attack resilience by 41 points.

Prime Intellect separately worked with NVIDIA to post-train Nemotron 3.5 Super VL on thousands of tasks across finance, sales, operations, and marketing, improving its AutomationBench-AA score by about 70%. AI21 Labs stated that these results demonstrate the ability of companies to achieve AI independence through sovereign specialized intelligence, reducing their reliance on broad, general-purpose models.
